sentiment: Sound is touch the air agrees to carry, then forgets — proof something moved through, even after the moving ends.

stories.title: Sound – Bartosz Ciechanowski (2022)
stories.summary: An interactive essay that lets you see sound instead of only hearing it — pressure, waves, and resonance made touchable.

stories.title: Show HN: Guitoro, a virtual guitar you strum with your keyboard
stories.summary: A keyboard becomes strings: play turns into a small, immediate pleasure you hear the instant a finger moves.
